source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 4 (PDF 75-92), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 4 (Work, Energy and Power) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define work done by a constant force. Derive its formula when the force makes an angle θ with the displacement, and show how the work is represented on a force-displacement graph. State when the work is positive, zero and negative. (5 marks)
(Constant force ke work ki definition likhein. Jab force displacement se θ angle banaye to is ka formula nikalein, aur dikhayein ke force-displacement graph par work kaise zahir hota hai. Batayein ke work kab positive, sifar aur negative hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Jab constant force F kisi jism ko apni simt mein d faasla le jaye to work W force aur displacement ki magnitudes ka hasil-e-zarb hai:
W = Fd ... (4.1)
Displacement sifar ho to bari force ke bawajood work sifar hai (maslan deewar dhakelna).

Angle par force: Force hamesha displacement ke rukh mein nahi hoti (Fig. 4.2). Agar F, d se θ angle banaye to sirf displacement ke rukh wala component F cos θ (Fig. 4.3) work karta hai:
W = (F cos θ)d = Fd cos θ ... (4.2)
ya W = F⃗·d⃗ ... (4.3)
Eq. (4.3) batati hai ke work scalar hai. SI unit joule: 1 J = 1 N m.

Graph: x-axis par displacement aur y-axis par force (Fig. 4.4). Constant force ufqi seedhi line deti hai. F aur d aik rukh mein hon to work Fd hai, jo rectangle OPQR ka area hai. Is liye force-displacement curve ke neeche ka area work hai. F, d ke rukh mein na ho to graph F cos θ aur d ke darmiyan banta hai.

Work ka nishan:
θ < 90°: positive work
θ = 90°: work sifar
θ > 90°: negative work

book_ref.quote: Let us consider an object which is being pulled by a constant force F.

blocks.prompt:
2 A gardener pushes a lawn mower 15 m along level ground with a force of 120 N directed along the handle at 30° to the ground. A frictional force of 80 N opposes the motion. Find (i) the work done by the gardener's force (ii) the work done by friction (iii) the net work done on the mower. (3 marks)
(Aik maali lawn mower ko hamwaar zameen par 15 m dhakelta hai; handle ke rukh mein 120 N force zameen se 30° par hai. 80 N ki friction harkat ki mukhalifat karti hai. Nikalein: (i) maali ki force ka work (ii) friction ka work (iii) mower par net work.)
blocks.explanation: Har force ke liye W = Fd cos θ: dhakelne ke liye θ = 30°, friction ke liye θ = 180°; phir jama karein.

book_ref.quote: the work done is equal to the product of the component of force along the direction of the displacement

blocks.prompt:
3 What is a variable force? Show that the work done by a variable force in moving a particle between two points equals the area under the F cos θ versus d curve. (5 marks)
(Variable force kya hai? Sabit karein ke variable force ka do points ke darmiyan work F cos θ banam d curve ke neeche ke area ke barabar hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Variable force: woh force jo work karte hue constant na rahe, maslan Zameen se door jate rocket par gravity (markaz se faasle ke inverse square ke mutabiq) aur spring ki force (khinchao ke saath barhti hai).

Derivation: Particle xy plane mein P se Q tak chalta hai (Fig. 4.5). Raaste ko n chhote hisson Δd₁, Δd₂, …, Δdₙ mein baantein jin mein forces F₁, F₂, …, Fₙ hain. Har chhote hisse mein force taqreeban constant hai, is liye
ΔW₁ = F₁ cos θ₁ Δd₁
ΔW₂ = F₂ cos θ₂ Δd₂, waghaira.
Kul work jama hai:
W_total = ΔW₁ + ΔW₂ + … + ΔWₙ
W_total = Σ Fᵢ cos θᵢ Δdᵢ ... (4.4)

Graph ka matlab: F cos θ ko d ke muqable mein banayein (Fig. 4.6). iᵗʰ rectangle ka area Fᵢ cos θᵢ Δdᵢ us hisse ka work hai, is liye Eq. 4.4 tamam rectangles ke areas ka jama hai. Zyada aur chhote hisson se nateeja behtar hota hai; har Δd → 0 karne se bilkul durust nateeja:
W_total = lim (Δd → 0) Σ Fᵢ cos θᵢ Δdᵢ ... (4.5)
Is limit mein rectangles ka kul area P se Q tak F cos θ banam d curve aur x-axis ke darmiyan area ban jata hai (Fig. 4.7).

Is liye variable force ka work do points ke darmiyan F cos θ banam d curve ke neeche ke area ke barabar hai.

book_ref.quote: The path has been divided into n short intervals of displacements

blocks.prompt:
4 A force acting on a body along its motion increases uniformly from 0 to 12 N as the body moves from d = 0 to d = 3 m, stays at 12 N from d = 3 m to d = 7 m, and then decreases uniformly to zero at d = 9 m. Find the total work done by the force. (3 marks)
(Jism par harkat ke rukh mein force d = 0 se 3 m tak yaksaan tor par 0 se 12 N barhti hai, d = 3 m se 7 m tak 12 N rehti hai, phir d = 9 m par yaksaan tor par sifar ho jati hai. Force ka kul work nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Work = force-distance graph ke neeche ka area: triangle, rectangle aur triangle.

book_ref.quote: Calculate the work done by the force as the object moves from d = 0 to d = 6 m.

blocks.prompt:
5 Define conservative and non-conservative forces. Show that the gravitational force is a conservative force by finding the work done by it along three different paths. Give examples of both kinds of force. (5 marks)
(Conservative aur non-conservative forces ki definition likhein. Teen mukhtalif raaston par work nikal kar sabit karein ke gravitational force conservative hai. Dono qismon ki misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Conservative force: Agar kisi force ka do points ke darmiyan work raaste par munhasir na ho, ya band raaste mein sifar ho, to woh conservative (mahfooz) force hai.
Non-conservative force: Agar force ka do points ke darmiyan ya band raaste mein work raaste par munhasir ho to woh non-conservative hai.

Gravity conservative hai: m mass ka jism constant speed se A se B (A se h ooncha) teen raaston se le jaya jata hai (Fig. 4.9). Gravitational force us ka weight mg hai.
Raasta 1 (ADB): AD par weight raaste par amoodi, work = 0. DB par mg displacement ke ulat (θ = 180°), work = −mgh.
W_ADB = 0 + (−mgh) = −mgh
Raasta 2 (ACB): AC par work −mgh; CB par sifar.
W_ACB = −mgh + 0 = −mgh
Raasta 3 (ghumawdaar): Curve ko ufqi aur amoodi qadmon mein torein (Fig. 4.10). Ufqi qadmon par mg amoodi hai, work sifar; sirf amoodi qadmon par work:
W_AB = −mg(Δy₁ + Δy₂ + … + Δyₙ)
Δy₁ + Δy₂ + … + Δyₙ = h, is liye W_AB = −mgh
Har raaste par work −mgh hai, yani gravity ka work raaste par munhasir nahi; band raaste ACBA par −mgh + mgh = 0. Is liye gravity conservative hai.

Non-conservative misaal: Kinetic friction harkat ke ulat hai aur friction × raaste ki lambai ke barabar manfi work karti hai, is liye lamba raasta zyada work; band raaste mein kul work sifar nahi.

Misalein:
Conservative: gravitational, electrostatic, elastic spring force.
Non-conservative: kinetic friction, hawa ki mazahmat, dhaage ka tension, normal force, rocket ki propulsion force.

book_ref.quote: Consider an object of mass m being displaced with constant speed from point A to B along various paths

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke AB par sab Δy 'negative' hain; asal baat yeh hai ke jism oopar ja raha hai jabke mg neeche hai, is liye har amoodi qadam par mg aur displacement ulat hain aur har qadam ka work manfi hai. Jama karne par −mgh aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
6 A 4 kg box is raised from the floor to a platform 2.5 m high, once by lifting it straight up and once by pushing it up a 6.0 m long ramp on which the kinetic friction is 10 N. Find (i) the work done by gravity along each path (ii) the work done by friction along the ramp (iii) the total work done by gravity and by friction if the box is pushed up the ramp and slid back down it to the floor. (3 marks)
(4 kg ka dabba farsh se 2.5 m oonche platform par aik dafa seedha utha kar aur aik dafa 6.0 m lambe ramp par dhakel kar le jaya jata hai; ramp par kinetic friction 10 N hai. Nikalein: (i) dono raaston par gravity ka work (ii) ramp par friction ka work (iii) agar dabba ramp par oopar dhakel kar wapas neeche phisla diya jaye to gravity aur friction ka kul work.)
blocks.explanation: Gravity ka work sirf oonchai ki tabdeeli par (−mgh); friction ka work −f × raaste ki lambai hai aur jama hota rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: When an object slides over a surface, the kinetic frictional force acts opposite to the motion

steps: Friction dono taraf ulat: −60 + (−60) = −120 J, sifar nahi
blocks.final_answer: (i) dono raaston par −98 J (ii) −60 J (iii) gravity 0, friction −120 J: gravity conservative, friction non-conservative

blocks.prompt:
7 Define power, average power and instantaneous power. Show that power is the dot product of force and velocity. Define the watt and the kilowatt-hour, and express 1 kW h in joules. (5 marks)
(Power, average power aur instantaneous power ki definition likhein. Sabit karein ke power force aur velocity ka dot product hai. Watt aur kilowatt-hour ki definition likhein aur 1 kW h ko joules mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Zaroorat: Work ki definition nahi batati ke kaam aik second mein hua ya aik ghante mein; amali kaamon mein kaam ki sharah ahem hai.

Power: Power woh sharah hai jis se work kiya ja raha ho.
Average power: Agar Δt waqt mein ΔW work ho,
P_av = ΔW/Δt ... (4.6)
Instantaneous power: Agar work time ka function ho to kisi lamhe par
P = lim (Δt → 0) ΔW/Δt ... (4.7)
jahan ΔW chhote waqfe Δt mein work hai.

Power = force · velocity:
ΔW = F⃗·Δd⃗, is liye
P = F⃗·Δd⃗/Δt = F⃗·(Δd⃗/Δt)
Δd⃗/Δt = v⃗, to
P = F⃗·v⃗ ... (4.8)

Watt: Power ki SI unit watt hai, aik second mein aik joule work (1 W = 1 J s⁻¹). Bijli ki pemaish mein work kabhi watt second mein likha jata hai.

Kilowatt-hour: Bijli ki energy ki commercial unit. Aik kilowatt power wala adara aik ghante mein jo work kare woh aik kilowatt-hour hai.
1 kW h = 1000 W × 3600 s = 3.6 × 10⁶ J = 3.6 MJ

book_ref.quote: The rate, at which work is done, is often of interest in practical applications.

blocks.prompt:
8 A lift of total mass 800 kg is raised at a steady speed through a height of 20 m in 16 s. Find (i) the work done against gravity (ii) the power of the motor from P = W/t (iii) the same power from P = Fv. (3 marks)
(800 kg kul mass wali lift yaksaan speed se 16 s mein 20 m oopar uthayi jati hai. Nikalein: (i) gravity ke khilaf work (ii) P = W/t se motor ki power (iii) P = Fv se wohi power.)
blocks.explanation: Yaksaan speed par uthane wali force weight mg ke barabar hai; work = mgh, aur P = W/t aur P = Fv dono aik hi power dein.

book_ref.quote: A 70 kg man runs up a long flight of stairs in 4.0 s.

blocks.prompt:
9 Define kinetic energy. Derive the expression K.E. = ½mv² for a body of mass m moving with speed v. What is its unit? (5 marks)
(Kinetic energy ki definition likhein. m mass aur v speed wale jism ke liye K.E. = ½mv² nikalein. Is ki unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Kinetic energy jism mein us ki harkat ki wajah se energy hai; harkat ki wajah se kaam karne ki salahiyat.

Derivation: m mass ki car v speed se chal rahi hai. Engine band karne par bhi woh rukne se pehle d faasla tay karti hai. Is dauran woh sarak ki friction f ke khilaf work karti hai, yani f ke barabar force lagati hai. Harkat ki wajah se car ka work fd hai, is liye
car ki kinetic energy = fd
Newton ke doosre qanoon se F = ma. Car ahista hoti hai to acceleration manfi hai kyunke friction harkat ke ulat hai:
f = −ma, ya a = −f/m
Harkat ki teesri masawat: 2aS = vf² − vi²
Yahan vi = v, vf = 0, S = d, a = −f/m
2 × (−f/m) d = 0 − v²
fd = ½mv²
fd jism ki kinetic energy hai, is liye
Kinetic energy = ½mv² ... (4.9)

Unit: Kinetic energy jism ke mumkin work ke barabar hai, is liye unit joule (J) hai.

book_ref.quote: Consider a car running with a constant speed on a road.

blocks.prompt:
10 A car of weight 14700 N is moving at 20 m s⁻¹. Its brakes bring it to rest in 50 m. Find (i) its mass (ii) its kinetic energy (iii) the average force of friction on it. (3 marks)
(14700 N weight wali car 20 m s⁻¹ se chal rahi hai. Brakes use 50 m mein rok dete hain. Nikalein: (i) us ka mass (ii) us ki kinetic energy (iii) us par friction ki average force.)
blocks.explanation: w = mg se m nikalein; K.E. ½mv² rukne se pehle work fd ke barabar hai.

book_ref.quote: The kinetic energy of the car is equal to the work done by it before stopping

blocks.prompt:
11 Define absolute gravitational potential energy. Derive the expression U = −GMm/r for a body at a distance r from the centre of the Earth, and write its value at the Earth's surface. (5 marks)
(Absolute gravitational potential energy ki definition likhein. Zameen ke markaz se r faasle par jism ke liye U = −GMm/r nikalein, aur Zameen ki satah par is ki qeemat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Kisi position par jism ki absolute gravitational potential energy gravity ka woh work hai jo use us position se infinity tak le jane mein ho, jahan gravity sifar ho jati hai.

mgh kyun nahi: mgh sirf satah ke qareeb durust hai jahan gravity taqreeban constant hai. Bare faasle par, point 1 se N tak (Fig. 4.11), force faasle ke murabba ke ulat badalti hai.

Derivation: 1 se N tak faasle ko Δr lambai ke chhote qadmon mein baantein taake har qadam mein force constant rahe. Points 1 aur 2 ke markaz O se faasle r₁ aur r₂ hain. Pehle qadam ka darmiyani nuqta
r = (r₁ + r₂)/2; r₂ = r₁ + Δr, is liye r = r₁ + Δr/2 ... (4.10)
Is qadam par force: F = GMm/r² ... (4.11)
(4.10) ka murabba: r² = r₁² + 2r₁(Δr/2) + (Δr/2)²
(Δr)² << r₁², chhor dein: r² = r₁² + r₁Δr
Δr = r₂ − r₁ rakhein: r² = r₁r₂
To F = GMm/(r₁r₂) ... (4.12)
1 se 2 tak work (displacement gravity ke ulat, θ = 180°):
W₁→₂ = −GMm Δr/(r₁r₂) = −GMm (1/r₁ − 1/r₂)
Isi tarah W₂→₃ = −GMm (1/r₂ − 1/r₃), …, W(N−1)→N = −GMm (1/r(N−1) − 1/r_N)
Sab jama karne par darmiyani terms cancel:
W_total = −GMm (1/r₁ − 1/r_N)
N infinity par ho to 1/r_N = 0:
W_total = −GMm/r₁
Yahi absolute P.E. hai, is liye r faasle par:
U = −GMm/r

Zameen ki satah par (r = R): U_g = −GMm/R ... (4.13)
Manfi nishan batata hai ke field kheenchne wala (attractive) hai. r barhne se U kam manfi yani barhta hai; satah se infinity tak le jane ke liye GMm/R work karna parta hai.

book_ref.quote: In order to overcome this difficulty, we divide the distance between points 1 and N into small steps

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Darmiyani terms ka cancel hona: (1/r₁ − 1/r₂) + (1/r₂ − 1/r₃) + … mein har −1/r₂ ke saath agla +1/r₂ kat jata hai, sirf pehli 1/r₁ aur aakhri 1/r_N bachti hain.

blocks.prompt:
12 A 500 kg satellite is taken from the Earth's surface to a distance 2R from the Earth's centre. Taking GM = 4.0 × 10¹⁴ m³ s⁻² and R = 6.4 × 10⁶ m, find (i) its absolute P.E. at the surface (ii) its absolute P.E. at 2R (iii) the work needed to raise it from R to 2R. (3 marks)
(500 kg ka satellite Zameen ki satah se Zameen ke markaz se 2R faasle tak le jaya jata hai. GM = 4.0 × 10¹⁴ m³ s⁻² aur R = 6.4 × 10⁶ m le kar nikalein: (i) satah par absolute P.E. (ii) 2R par absolute P.E. (iii) R se 2R tak uthane ke liye work.)
blocks.explanation: r = R aur r = 2R par U = −GMm/r lagayein; zaroori work U ka izafa hai.

book_ref.quote: Now the absolute potential energy on the surface of the Earth is found by putting r = R

blocks.prompt:
13 Define escape velocity. Derive the expressions v_esc = √(2GM/R) and v_esc = √(2gR), and state its approximate value for the Earth. (5 marks)
(Escape velocity ki definition likhein. v_esc = √(2GM/R) aur v_esc = √(2gR) nikalein, aur Zameen ke liye is ki taqreebi qeemat batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Khayal: Oopar phenki cheez gravity ki wajah se wapas aati hai. Zyada ibtidai velocity se zyada ooncha jati hai; aik khaas velocity par wapas nahi aati aur gravity ke asar se nikal jati hai.

Definition: Woh ibtidai velocity jis se jism Zameen ke gravitational field se nikal jaye escape velocity hai.

Derivation: Escape velocity woh ibtidai K.E. deti hai jo jism ko satah se infinity tak le jaye:
Ibtidai K.E. = ½mv_esc²
Satah se infinity tak uthane ka work P.E. ke izafe ke barabar hai:
P.E. ka izafa = 0 − (−GMm/R) = GMm/R
jahan M aur R Zameen ka mass aur radius hain. Ibtidai K.E. is izafe ke barabar ho to jism nikal jata hai:
½mv_esc² = GMm/R
v_esc = √(2GM/R) ... (4.14)
g = GM/R², is liye GM/R = gR, aur
v_esc = √(2gR) ... (4.15)

Jism ka mass m cancel ho jata hai, is liye escape velocity jism ke mass par munhasir nahi. Zameen ke liye v_esc taqreeban 11 km s⁻¹ (table mein 11.2 km s⁻¹).

book_ref.quote: The escape velocity corresponds to the initial kinetic energy gained by the body, which carries it to an infinite distance from the surface of the Earth.

blocks.prompt:
14 The acceleration due to gravity at the surface of the Moon is 1.6 m s⁻² and its radius is 1.74 × 10⁶ m. Find the escape velocity from the Moon and compare it with the value in the chapter's table. (3 marks)
(Chaand ki satah par g = 1.6 m s⁻² aur us ka radius 1.74 × 10⁶ m hai. Chaand se escape velocity nikalein aur chapter ke table ki qeemat se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Chaand ka g aur R v_esc = √(2gR) mein rakhein.

book_ref.quote: The value of v_esc comes out to be approximately 11 km s⁻¹.

steps: ≈ 2.4 km s⁻¹, table mein Chaand ki qeemat jitni

blocks.prompt:
15 State and derive the work-energy theorem. Explain why it holds for any direction of the force and for a varying force. (5 marks)
(Work-energy theorem bayan karein aur sabit karein. Wazahat karein ke yeh force ki har simt aur badalti force ke liye kyun durust hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Bayan: Jism ki kinetic energy mein tabdeeli us par net force ke work ke barabar hai. Ise work-energy principle bhi kehte hain.

Derivation: Jab jism par work hota hai to us ki energy barhti hai. m mass ke jism par force F amal karti hai jo ibtidai velocity vi se chal raha hai; d faasle mein velocity vf ho jati hai. Harkat ki teesri masawat se:
2ad = vf² − vi²
a = (1/2d)(vf² − vi²) ... (4.16)
Newton ke doosre qanoon se F = ma, ya
a = F/m ... (4.17)
(4.16) aur (4.17) ka muqabla:
F/m = (1/2d)(vf² − vi²)
Fd = ½mvf² − ½mvi² ... (4.18)
W = K.E. ki tabdeeli = (K.E.)f − (K.E.)i

Umoomiyat: Theorem force ki har simt ke liye hai. Agar K.E. wala jism doosre ko dhakele ya kheenche to work manfi liya jata hai aur us ki K.E. kam hoti hai. Force jagah jagah badle tab bhi theorem durust hai.

book_ref.quote: This expression is the work-energy theorem. It states that:

blocks.prompt:
16 A 40 kg block starts down a 30° slope at 2.0 m s⁻¹. The kinetic frictional force on it is 80 N. Using the work-energy theorem, find its speed after it has slid 20 m down the slope (sin 30° = 0.5). (3 marks)
(40 kg ka block 30° slope par 2.0 m s⁻¹ se neeche chalna shuru karta hai. Us par kinetic friction 80 N hai. Work-energy theorem se 20 m neeche phisalne ke baad us ki speed nikalein (sin 30° = 0.5).)
blocks.explanation: Slope ke saath net force (mg sin θ − f), us ka work Fd nikal kar ibtidai K.E. mein jama karein.

book_ref.quote: A motorcycle rider weighing 60 kg is coasting down a 24° slope.

blocks.prompt:
17 Show that for a freely falling body (air friction ignored) the total energy at every point of its fall is mgh, and hence that loss in P.E. equals gain in K.E. (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke azadana girte jism (hawa ki ragar nahi) ki kul energy girne ke har point par mgh hai, aur is se P.E. ka nuqsan K.E. ke faide ke barabar hai.)
blocks.explanation:
m mass ka jism h oonchai par saakin hai (Fig. 4.12).

A par (oopar): P.E. = mgh, K.E. = 0, kul = mgh.

B par (x faasla gir chuka):
P.E. = mg(h − x)
K.E. = ½mvB²
vf² = vi² + 2gS se (vf = vB, vi = 0, S = x): vB² = 2gx
K.E. = ½m(2gx) = mgx
Kul energy = mg(h − x) + mgx = mgh ... (4.19)

C par (zameen se zara pehle): P.E. = 0
vC² = 2gh
K.E. = ½m × 2gh = mgh
Yani C par K.E. asal P.E. ke barabar hai.

Nateeja: Girte hue velocity aur K.E. barhti hai, oonchai aur P.E. ghatti hai; kul mgh rehti hai. Oonchaiyon h₁, h₂ par velocities v₁, v₂ hon to (Fig. 4.13):
P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida
mg(h₁ − h₂) = ½m(v₂² − v₁²) ... (4.20)
Yeh sirf tab durust hai jab friction shamil na ho.

book_ref.quote: Consider a body of mass m at rest, at a height h above the surface of the Earth

blocks.prompt:
18 A 2 kg ball is released from rest at a height of 30 m. Ignoring air friction, find its P.E., K.E. and total energy (i) at the start (ii) after it has fallen 10 m (iii) after it has fallen 20 m, and (iv) its speed just before it hits the ground. (3 marks)
(2 kg ki gaind 30 m oonchai se saakin haalat mein chhori jati hai. Hawa ki ragar nazarandaz karke us ki P.E., K.E. aur kul energy nikalein (i) shuru mein (ii) 10 m girne ke baad (iii) 20 m girne ke baad, aur (iv) zameen se takrane se zara pehle us ki speed.)
blocks.explanation: P.E. = mg(h − x), K.E. = mgx; kul mgh rehti hai. Zameen par sab K.E. hai.

book_ref.quote: Let us calculate P.E. and K.E. at the position B when the body has fallen a distance x, ignoring air friction.

blocks.final_answer: Kul energy 588 J rehti hai; zameen par speed = 24.2 m s⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
19 Explain how the conservation of energy of a falling body is modified when a frictional force acts on it. Derive mgh = ½mv² + fh and write the corresponding relation for a body moving up against friction. (5 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke friction ki maujoodgi mein girte jism ki energy ka rishta kaise badalta hai. mgh = ½mv² + fh nikalein aur friction ke khilaf oopar jate jism ka rishta likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Friction ke baghair girte jism ki khoi hui sari P.E. K.E. banti hai: mg(h₁ − h₂) = ½m(v₂² − v₁²). Yeh sirf friction ke baghair durust hai.

Friction ke saath: Neeche girte hue h oonchai mein jism par friction f amal kare. P.E. ka kuch hissa friction ke khilaf fh work mein lagta hai. Sirf baqi P.E., mgh − fh, K.E. banti hai:
mgh − fh = ½mv²
mgh = ½mv² + fh ... (4.21)
Yani:
P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida + friction ke khilaf work

Ulat, oopar jate jism (ya band engine ke saath charhai charhti car) ki K.E. ka kuch hissa P.E. banta hai aur kuch friction ke khilaf work mein lagta hai:
K.E. ka nuqsan = P.E. ka faida + friction ke khilaf work
½m(vi² − vf²) = mgh + fd, jahan d friction ke khilaf tay kiya faasla hai.

Hamwaar sarak par (oonchai nahi badalti) rukne se pehle sari K.E. friction ke khilaf lagti hai: ½mv² = fS.

blocks.prompt:
20 A 1000 kg car moving at 15 m s⁻¹ has its engine stop at point P. It coasts 30 m up a slope to point Q, which is 2.0 m higher than P, against a frictional force of 150 N. Find (i) its speed at Q (ii) how far it goes on a level road beyond Q before stopping, against the same friction. (3 marks)
(1000 kg ki car 15 m s⁻¹ se chal rahi hai ke point P par us ka engine band ho jata hai. Woh 150 N friction ke khilaf 30 m charhai charh kar point Q par pohanchti hai jo P se 2.0 m ooncha hai. Nikalein: (i) Q par us ki speed (ii) Q ke baad hamwaar sarak par usi friction ke khilaf woh kitna faasla tay karke rukti hai.)
blocks.explanation: P se Q: K.E. ka nuqsan = P.E. ka faida + friction ka work. Q ke baad hamwaar sarak: ½mv² = fS.

book_ref.quote: How far beyond Q will it go before coming to rest?
